SFUI_EnableGyro_Info: Choose when Gyro Aim should be enabled. Always On is recommended.
SFUI_FlickStickActive_Info: In FlickStick mode, push the stick in a direction to Snap your horizontal aim in that direction. Sweep the stick around to continuously rotate the player.
SFUI_FlickStickSensitivity_Info: Multiply how much you rotate by when Sweeping the Flick Stick. 1.0 = One to One.
SFUI_FlickStickSnapAngle_Info: removes all snapping. snaps to the front using Front Angle Deadzone.
SFUI_FlickStickSnapDuration_Info: How quickly the initial Snap occurs. 100% = instant. 0% = Smoothed.
SFUI_FlickStickTightness_Info: How smoothly the player yaw follows the Sweeping. 100% = Instant. 0%= Smoothed. Use some smoothing to reduce controller noise.
SFUI_FlickStick_DeadzoneMin_Info: The amount of joystick-deflection required to trigger a Snap, and to use Sweeping motions to rotate horizontally
SFUI_FlickStick_FrontDeadzone_Info: Ignore the initiation FlickStick rotation if it falls inside this number of degrees either side of Forward.
SFUI_GameModeTrainingDesc: Prepare yourself for the war in Vietnam!
SFUI_GyroDeadzone_Info: Angles per Second. Gyro Controller motions smaller than this will be removed completely. Not recommended.
SFUI_GyroPrecisionZone_Info: Angles per Second. Gyro Controller motions smaller than this will be ramped down. Useful for shaky hands.
SFUI_Gyro_Acceleration_Info: When disabled, Gyro movement will only be multiplied by Base Sensitivity. When enabled sensitivity uses Base Sensitivity at Base Speed Threshold and Base Sensitivity multiplied by Fast Multiplier at Fast Speed Threshold
SFUI_Gyro_DeadzoneMin_Info: Gyro deflection less than this will be remapped to zero.
SFUI_Gyro_HighSenseMul_Info: When turn speed is at Fast Speed Threshold or higher, sensitivity will be Base Sensitivity multiplied by this. Useful for pure Gyro users.
SFUI_Gyro_HighSenseSpeed_Info: Gyro speeds equal to or above this speed will be multiplied by Fast Sensitivity. In between speeds are blended.
SFUI_Gyro_LowSenseMul_Info: This sensitivity will be used when the gyro turns at the Base Speed Threshold or below.
SFUI_Gyro_LowSenseSpeed_Info: Gyro speeds equal to or below this speed will use the Base Sensitivity. In between speeds are blended.
SFUI_Gyro_PitchDeadzone_Info: Angles per Second. Increase this to bias Gyro Aim horizontally.
SFUI_Gyro_Ratio_Info: At 50%, Pitch and Yaw are balanced. At 100% only Pitch is used. At 0% only Yaw is used
SFUI_Gyro_YawDeadzone_Info: Angles per Second. Increase this to bias Gyro Aim vertically.
SFUI_Hint_Accurate_Range: A weapon's Accurate Range is the distance at which the weapon is guaranteed to hit a 30 cm dinner plate (from a standstill).
SFUI_Hint_Reticule_Spread: The outer aiming reticule indicates the spread of your weapon. The wider it is, the more inaccurate your shot will be.
SFUI_JoystickAimTurningExtraRampUpDelay_: While the aim stick is fully deflected horizontally, wait this long before increasing toward the Extra Yaw Speed.
SFUI_JoystickAimTurningExtraRampUpTime_I: While the aim stick is fully deflected horizontally, it will take this many seconds to get the full Extra Yaw Speed.
SFUI_JoystickAimTurningExtraYaw_Info: While the aim stick is fully deflected horizontally, yaw rate will gradually increase by this amount.
SFUI_JoystickMoveSquareDeadzoneForward_I: Increase this to bias/snap strafing movements.
SFUI_JoystickMoveSquareDeadzoneStrafe_In: Increase this to bias/snap movement forward and backwards.
SFUI_Joystick_DeadzoneMax_Info: Joystick deflection greater than this will be remapped to maximum deflection.
SFUI_Joystick_DeadzoneMin_Info: Joystick deflection less than this will be remapped to zero.

SFUI_Settings_Antialiasing_Info: Anti-aliasing provides a smooth appearance at the edges of geometry, eliminating jagged edges. Increasing anti-aliasing quality can degrade graphics performance.
SFUI_Settings_Brightness: Change the gamma correction of the display, adjusting overall brightness. Only available in full screen mode.
SFUI_Settings_CPUDetail_Info: Effect detail controls the complexity of certain visual effects in the game as well as the draw-distance. Decreasing the effect detail may improve performance but will also increase model pop-in artifacts.
SFUI_Settings_CSM_Info: Global shadow quality controls the fidelity of the dynamic shadows cast onto surfaces in the game. Higher settings increase the visual quality but can degrade CPU and graphics performance.
SFUI_Settings_ClanTag_In_Death_Notice: Display Team Tags In Death Notices
SFUI_Settings_Enable_Audio_Background: Play Audio When Game In Background
SFUI_Settings_Enable_Audio_HWCompat_Tip: MC:V applies 3D audio effects to in-game sounds. It is recommended that you turn off any audio processing on your audio hardware as it may interfere with MC:V's effects. Disabling MC:V's 3D processing can be used to diagnose hardware compatibility problems.
SFUI_Settings_FXAA_Info: Anti-aliasing provides a smooth appearance at the edges of geometry, eliminating jagged edges. Enabling FXAA can degrade graphics performance.
SFUI_Settings_Filtering_Info: Increasing the texture filtering setting improves the appearance of textures in the game. Increasing filtering quality can degrade graphics performance.
SFUI_Settings_HUDScaling_Info: HUD Scale adjusts the size of all HUD elements.
SFUI_Settings_HUD_BackgroundAlpha_Info: Adjusts the background opacity of the money, health, location and ammo displays.
SFUI_Settings_HUD_Color_Info: This color is applied to selected parts of the HUD, including health, armor and ammo.
SFUI_Settings_HUD_Color_Info_2: This color is applied to red parts of the HUD.
SFUI_Settings_HUD_Radar_Size_Info: Adjusts the size of the radar relative to other HUD elements.
SFUI_Settings_HUD_Radar_Style_Info: Toggles between circle and square radar.
SFUI_Settings_Microphone_Config_Tip: Controls from which device MC:V will capture input sound.
SFUI_Settings_ModelDetail_Info: The Model and Texture detail setting controls the resolution of textures and geometric complexity of models in the game. Decreasing this setting may improve performance on low-end systems, but will degrade image quality.
SFUI_Settings_MotionBlur_Info: Motion Blur is a fullscreen shader effect that selectively smooths the frame during rapid changes in the camera's angle or position. The Disabled setting may result in slightly improved graphics performance.
SFUI_Settings_MuteAllButFriends_Tooltip: Block communication from everyone except players you are friends with or players in your matchmaking party.
SFUI_Settings_Network_Bandwidth_Info:
Allows to specify game traffic bandwidth that online game servers send to you during gameplay.

Lower bandwidth rate setting can help avoid packet loss if your internet service provider or routers drop network packets.

Insufficient bandwidth rate however can result in delayed network packets at times when game server sends updates about multiple other players over the network to your client.
SFUI_Settings_Paged_Pool_Mem_Info: Available CPU memory may be affected by other programs, such as anti-virus programs running in the background.
SFUI_Settings_PowerSavings_Info: In Power Savings Mode, the game intentionally runs at a low frame rate in order to preserve battery power, extending the amount of time that you can play on battery power.
SFUI_Settings_QueuedMode_Info: Multicore rendering allows MC:V to utilize the multiple CPUs present in your system. The Disabled setting may provide more stability on certain systems but can lower framerate.
SFUI_Settings_Radar_Display_Mode_Info: Various options to display the radar when Radar button is pressed (defined in keyboard settings).
SFUI_Settings_Radar_Rotate_Info: Toggles between a radar that rotates and a radar with a fixed orientation.
SFUI_Settings_Radar_Scale_Info: Map Zoom impacts the amount of the map that is visible on the radar.
SFUI_Settings_RestartRequired_Desc: Some changes require restarting the game for all settings to apply correctly.
SFUI_Settings_SanitizeNames_Title_Toolti: Change names of players not on your friends list to something neutral.
SFUI_Settings_ShaderDetail_Info: Shader detail controls the sophistication of the lighting and shading effects applied to surfaces in the game. Higher settings increase visual quality but can degrade graphics performance.
SFUI_Settings_Speaker_Config_Tip: Controls the number of channels in which MC:V outputs sound.
SFUI_Settings_TextureStreaming_Info: Texture streaming allows the game to defer loading of high-resolution textures until they are needed for rendering. Disabling this setting will result in increased texture memory consumption. On systems with slower disk access, streaming textures may be momentarily visible.
SFUI_Settings_VOIP_Volume_Tip: Overall volume of voice over IP
SFUI_Settings_WaitForVSync_Info: Triple Buffering is recommended for the smoothest experience. The Disabled setting may cause visual tearing.
SFUI_Settings_alt_ironsight_offset_toolt: Changes between Semi-Realistic and Original weapon viewmodel distance from the screen when you aim down sights.
SFUI_Settings_buffered_weapon_input_tool: Changes non-automatic weapons behavior to queue the clicks instead of simply ignoring them in cases when the user does not click in the correct rate-of-fire limited timeframe.
SFUI_Settings_sound_mixahead_Tip: Controls sound processing quality, lower is better. Increasing this may fix sound issues on certain hardware.
SFUI_Settings_viewroll_tilt_tooltip: Tilts player camera by this value while sprinting.

Vietnam_Settings_FoliageSmoothing_Info: Use Multisampling to improve transparency of distant alpha-tested materials (example: Foliage)
Vietnam_Settings_LensFlare_Info: Screen Space Lens Flare increases the perceived brightness of objects and the apparent dynamic range of the image. Enabling Lens Flare may lead to a slight decrease in performance.
Vietnam_Settings_LimitRagdolls_Info: If limited, ragdolls will be forcefully faded out shortly after death, which can save some performance.
Vietnam_Settings_MuzzleflashLight_Info: Controls type of effect for muzzleflash light. Dynamic Light - fastest but worst quality, Projected - fast but good quality, Projected + Shadow - slowest but best quality
Vietnam_Settings_ParallaxMapping_Info: Parallax Mapping controls the visual effect of giving the illusion of depth to textures due to parallax effects as the view changes. Disabling this settings can increase graphical performance.
Vietnam_Settings_RefractParticles_Info: Disable rendering of particle heat effects to save performance.
Vietnam_Settings_SMAA_Info: SMAA is a very efficient GPU-based MLAA implementation, capable of handling subpixel features seamlessly, and featuring an improved and advanced pattern detection & handling mechanism.
Vietnam_Settings_SSAO_Info: Screen Space Ambient Obscurance darkens creases, holes and surfaces that are close to each other. The resulting shading makes objects more visible. Enabling SSAO can degrade graphics performance.

vietnam_maps_description_mcv_airbase: During the Tet Offensive, the airbase came under heavy attack by PAVN and Việt Cộng forces. U.S. and ARVN troops defended the position sustaining heavy losses. The base was evacuated and the surrounding area heavily bombed, marking it as one of the few major airfields abandoned by U.S. forces during the war.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_bridge: At Dầu Máu Bridge, a small unit of ███ ████████ held strong to allow civilians to escape. With no means of retreat, they maintained the position until the last man.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_bunkerhill: PAVN and Việt Cộng forces took the Vọng Cảnh Hill during the Tet Offensive. The hill overlooked Highway 1 and was a key position near Huế city. U.S. and ARVN forces have retaken the base after heavy fighting.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_camp: Cửa Việt Combat Base was a key U.S. Marine position near the Demilitarized Zone. Its coastal location made it vital for supplying operations in northern South Vietnam and a frequent target for PAVN attacks.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_church: PAVN forces attacked the town of An Lộc during the Easter Offensive. Surrounded and under constant fire, ARVN troops held the town with help from U.S. air support, turning the battle into a symbol of South Vietnamese resistance.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_citadel: At the very start of the Tet Offensive, PAVN and Việt Cộng forces attacked the city of Quảng Trị. After intense fighting, ARVN forces repelled the assault and retained control of the city.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_depot: From January 21 to July 9, 1968, U.S. forces defended Khe Sanh Combat Base against concentrated PAVN attacks. The siege ended in a U.S. victory, but the base was later abandoned, raising questions about its strategic value.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_embassy: At the start of the Tet Offensive, Việt Cộng sappers broke into the U.S. Embassy in Sài Gòn through a hole in the wall and held the grounds for several hours. By noon, the U.S. forces have taken back the embassy, killing all the attackers.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_factory: The Z1 Factory was built in the mountains of North Vietnam between 1957 and 1959. The country's first major small arms factory produced weaponry often carried along the Hồ Chí Minh Trail down south to support PAVN and Việt Cộng forces.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_firebase: Fire Base Los Banos was one of dozens outposts constructed to provide fire support to patrols in the Lăng Cô Bay area. It housed watchtowers, bunkers, artillery, and repurposed French fortifications.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_halong_port: The Port of Hạ Long was an important North Vietnamese harbor in the Guld of Tonkin. It handled supplies, coal exports, and allied shipments, while remaining a key target during U.S. bombing campaigns.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_hospital: From 1966 to 1973, the 3rd Field Hospital near Tân Sơn Nhứt Air Base treated wounded American and allied troops. Fighting during the Tet Offensive made the surrounding area significantly more dangerous, but it remained one of the mos█ █████████ U.S. medical centers in Việt Nam.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_jungle: The Hồ Chí Minh Trail was a secret supply route used by North Việt Nam. Running through Laos and Cambodia, it allowed troops, weapons, and supplies to reach the southern battlefield, despite U.S. counteroperations.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_mansion: At Phú Thọ Plantation, a North Vietnamese unit stayed behind to cover a civilian evacuation. As ████████ advanced across the rice fields, the unit held the mansion until it was overrun.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_notre_dam: During the Fall of Sài Gòn, civilians and soldiers fortified Notre-Dame Cathedral against a seemingly never-ending assault. The structure was barricaded and defended until it was engulfed by ███████.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_outpost: The A Shau Valley was a major infiltration route used by PAVN forces. Long Range Reconnaissance Patrols were sent deep into the jungle to gathered intelligence, track movement, and sa██████ ████ ████ supply lines.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_port: In 1965, the U.S. military helped expand the Port of Quy Nhơn to move supplies and troops more efficiently. Linked to the North–South railway, the port was very important for logistics. It was often a target of Việt Cộng sabotage and artillery.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_post: During the Tet Offensive, PAVN and Việt Cộng forces attacked Long Bình Post and nearby Biên Hòa Air Base. American and allied troops repelled the assault after heavy fighting, keeping the base relatively intact and under U.S. control.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_prison: At Hỏa Lò Prison in Hà Nội, small group of guards and USAF prisoners held the complex as infected flooded the surrounding streets. Former enemies fought side by side, turning the prison into a final stand.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_ricefield: A major battle broke out in the rice fields near Cao Lãnh between Việt Cộng units and South Vietnamese troops backed by U.S. advisors. The inconclusive fights highlighted the challenges of counterinsurgency in the Mekong Delta.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_ruins: At Wat Phou Temple in southern Laos, a small detachment of soldiers stood their ground as ████████ came down from the nearby mountains. The unit held strong at the ancient sanctuary to buy time for villages along the Mekong Delta to evacuate.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_saigon: Việt Cộng forces launched coordinated attacks across the whole Sài Gòn to begin the Tet Offensive. Heavy firefights with U.S. and ARVN troops erupted across the whole city and lasted weeks, leaving serious damage throughout the capital.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_siege: The city of Huế, located near the DMZ and along Highway 1, was captured by PAVN and Việt Cộng forces during the Tet Offensive. It was taken back by U.S. Marines and South Vietnamese (ARVN) troops after weeks of brutal urban fighting.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_slums: During the Tet Offensive, Việt Cộng forces attacked the city of Cần Thơ located along the Mekong Delta. U.S. and ARVN troops fought to secure the city and surrounging waterways.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_temple: During the Tet Offensive, fighting spread into the picturesque Hội An and the surrounding countryside. U.S. and ARVN forces conducted patrols and search operations against Việt Cộng units operating in the area.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_tower: At Tân Sơn Nhứt Air Base, a small group of U.S. and South Vietnamese troops held the control tower during the final evacuation. Surrounded by ████████ and low on ammunition, they maintained the position until overrun.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_training: This camp prepared U.S. Army soldiers for combat in Việt Nam with help of live-fire ranges, obstacle courses, medical training, and jungle drills to get troops ready for operations against North Vietnamese and Việt Cộng forces in tough terrain.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_usns_card: Việt Cộng commandos swam through a sewer tunnel in Sài Gòn to reach the U.S. Navy carrier ship docked in the harbor. They planted explosives and escaped, sinking the ship in one of the first major sabotage missions of the war.
vietnam_maps_description_mcv_village: Near the Laotian border, Minh Hóa was an important gateway to the Hồ Chí Minh Trail. North Vietnamese troops and supplies moved through the surrounding mountains despite frequent U.S. bombing raids.

workshopmenu_upload_addon:
- To upload addon you need to navigate to "vietnam" folder of your MCV installation. You can right click on MCV in Steam library, click Properties, then Local Files then Browse.
- Now open "vietnam" folder and create new folder "workshop".
- Inside folder "workshop" create a folder with your addon name (ex. "my_addon").
- Now create respective directories for all content you would like to upload: "maps" for maps, "models" for models, etc.
- After that, go to Workshop Menu ingame, select Upload Addon, click Browse and select your addon folder, then fill remaining data.
- Make sure to read and sign Steam Workshop Contribution agreement and click Publish Item. You are done.
workshopmenu_upload_map:
- To upload map addon you need to navigate to "vietnam" folder of your MCV installation. You can right click on MCV in Steam library, click Properties, then Local Files then Browse.
- Now open "vietnam" folder and create new folder "workshop".
- Inside folder "workshop" create a folder with your addon name (ex. "my_map").
- Now create directory "maps" and put your map in there. If you have additional content (textures, models, sounds, ect.) you have to create respective folders for them too ("models" for models, "sound" for sounds, and so on).
- Good practice is to pack all custom content required by map inside map file, you can use Pack BSP feature to automatically pack "materials", "models", "sound", and "resource" folders in your .bsp file, but you don't have to.
- You can also add preview images of your map for server browser and loading screen. Create folder(s) "materials/panorama/images/map_icons" inside your addon's folder. To create server browser preview create folder "playmenu" and put in there your desired image in .png format with 384x216 resolution. To create loading screen preview go back to "map_icons" folder and create folder "screenshots" - then put in there your desired image in .png format in at least 1080p resolution.
- After that, go to Workshop Menu ingame, select Upload Map, click Browse and select your map file, then fill remaining data. If you have a preview image you can name it the same as your map, save as .jpg and place inside your addon folder and the game will automatically detect it.
- Note that supported gamemodes are auto-detected according to entities present in map. You can toggle switches if you feel like something is wrong.
- Make sure to read and sign Steam Workshop Contribution agreement and click Publish Item. You are done.
